title: Flores Earthquake Tracker Update — Aug 28, 2026
summary: President Prabowo Subianto finally visited the earthquake zone on 26 August — eleven days after the mainshock, after two prior postponements — distributing Rp200 billion in aid across NTT province and its eight affected regencies. The confirmed death toll rose to 111 by 27 August before holding flat on Day 14 with no new fatalities reported. Displacement declined for the first time since the quake, falling from a 185,131 peak on 25 August to 176,621 on 27 August as families began returning home. BNPB's verified homes-damaged count rose to 77,912, and the agency launched an accelerated rehabilitation-reconstruction push across all seven affected regencies. Aftershocks passed 8,193.

title: Flores Earthquake Tracker Update — Aug 21, 2026
summary: BNPB and BPBD NTT raised the confirmed death toll to 83 (up from 75) as of 21 August, with displacement surging past 110,000 and homes damaged reaching 44,946. A magnitude 5.8 aftershock on 20 August triggered a fatal heart attack in Ruteng, and a previously uncounted 15 August death in Flores Timur Regency surfaced five days late, exposing a gap in the regency-level reporting system. Two cabinet ministers visited Sikka Regency on 19 August to distribute aid and condolence payments. BMKG has now recorded over 4,258 aftershocks since the mainshock.
